adjudications.name: underlyingError
adjudications.note: The only conformance to ProcessingError is Ingestion.Error. Its level and description read its own underlyingError. No code asks for underlyingError on the protocol. The concrete error still needs the property.

adjudications.name: status
adjudications.note: Common.swift:142 uses failure.status on the concrete Ingestion.Error in the Result array. The protocol declaration and the conformance are the only type uses of ProcessingError. Removing its status requirement leaves the concrete read intact.

adjudications.name: package
adjudications.note: Ingestion.fetchMetadata takes a package but forwards only owner and repository to each of the three GitHub dependencies at Ingestion.swift:281–283. Neither the production call nor the direct test requires a package value for this operation.

adjudications.name: value
adjudications.note: ActorIsolated is in the App target. The separately exported products are Authentication and S3Store. The value getter and setter compiled with internal access for the server and its tests.

adjudications.name: init(_:)
adjudications.note: The App module's generic actor initializer compiled with internal access for all targets including Run and AppTests. AppTests imports App with @testable.

adjudications.name: user
adjudications.note: The method body does not use user. Its comment says to keep the instrumentation for future use, and the disabled postEvent_package test expects this user's identifier in the request. Removal preserves today's no-op but discards an expressly documented input.

adjudications.name: succeeded
adjudications.note: This computed property is fileprivate in effect through a private HTTPStatus extension. Its spelling occurs only in its declaration in Analytics.swift. The no-op postEvent does not check a response status.

adjudications.name: props
adjudications.note: This private Optional<User> getter merely forwards to Analytics.props(for:). AnalyticsTests calls that static function directly. There is no client of the getter in its file.

adjudications.name: Level
adjudications.note: No source or test names AppError.Level. Commands use Logger.Level, and AppError's errorDescription forwards directly to localizedDescription.

adjudications.name: increment(key:)
adjudications.note: The live RedisClient dependency calls the private Redis actor's increment(key:by:) at RedisClient.swift:53. The one-argument actor method has no caller. The similarly named convenience on RedisClient is a separate type's method.

adjudications.name: query
adjudications.note: Github.fetchResource encodes its GraphQLQuery argument with JSONEncoder at Github.swift:195. Synthesized encoding reads the query property to produce the GitHub request body.

adjudications.name: target
adjudications.note: The package API reads the joined target's type and name at API+PackageController.swift:104–106. Removing its own ignore at Joined4+ext.swift:48 eliminated the hint and exposed no finding on this declaration.

adjudications.name: build
adjudications.note: PackageController+BuildsRoute.swift:60–73 queries this Joined5 specialization and reads res.build. Dropping the ignore above the accessor introduced no diagnostic on it.

adjudications.name: serialize(_:)
adjudications.note: The joined builder's convenience wraps queryBuilder.serialize(processSQL). That call is on the inner Fluent builder. No caller invokes serialize on JoinedQueryBuilder. Test SQL serialization uses separate SQLExpression overloads.

adjudications.name: packageId
adjudications.note: RecentRelease requires package_id through CodingKeys, and its SQL query decodes RecentRelease at line 64. Removing this property's ignore eliminated the hint without exposing a finding.

adjudications.name: model
adjudications.note: Ref3.model has no ignore of its own. The only actionable comment is on Ref3 at line 59. Removing it produced three new unused-generic findings on R1, R2 and R3 at line 60. The enclosing suppression still has an effect.

adjudications.name: attempt
adjudications.note: BackoffStrategy has only the constant case. delay(attempt:) always sleeps for that duration. Retry.run separately passes the attempt number to the user's operation, which can keep using it after the delay parameter is removed.

adjudications.name: updatedAt
adjudications.note: The update timestamp is a Fluent-managed property with a dedicated ignore. Removing that comment exposed no diagnostic on updatedAt or its enclosing model.

adjudications.name: executable
adjudications.note: Manifest.ProductType.init(from:) asks the decoder for a container keyed by this CodingKeys enum. JSONDecoder constructs the executable key when allKeys enumerates the manifest object, then line 151 switches on it.

adjudications.name: library
adjudications.note: The library key comes from the decoded object through container.allKeys at Manifest.swift:147. The library branch opens a nested unkeyed container for that key. Removing it prevents decoding library products.

adjudications.name: plugin
adjudications.note: JSONDecoder constructs the plugin CodingKey from the JSON property name. Manifest.ProductType.init(from:) selects the plugin branch at line 157 using that key.

adjudications.name: test
adjudications.note: JSONDecoder constructs the test CodingKey while enumerating the manifest object's keys. The test branch at Manifest.swift:159 maps that key to the product type.

adjudications.name: isPlugin
adjudications.note: No source or test references isPlugin. The computed getter wraps a switch over ProductType, whose cases remain usable without this getter.

adjudications.name: createdAt
adjudications.note: Fluent discovers the create-trigger timestamp through Fields.properties. FluentKit's Model+Concurrency.swift calls touchTimestamps(.create, .update) on creation, and Timestamp.swift writes the date into the matching wrapper. Removing it changes what Product saves in created_at.

adjudications.name: history()
adjudications.note: This is an ordinary method in a Swift Testing suite. Nearby history_archived_package has @Test. history() has no test attribute and is never called directly.

adjudications.name: activity_variants__missing_last_closed_issue()
adjudications.note: The only occurrence of this method name is its declaration. It has no @Test attribute. The separately named combined missing-issue-and-PR test at line 343 is registered.

adjudications.name: activity_variants__missing_last_closed_PR()
adjudications.note: This otherwise uncalled method lacks @Test. The adjacent combined case has its own @Test annotation and does not call this helper.

adjudications.name: init(_:)
adjudications.note: QueueIsolated belongs to the AppTests test target. Its initializer compiled as internal for every test caller without exposing it outside that module.

adjudications.name: withValue(_:)
adjudications.note: The mutating closure accessor is used inside AppTests. The pinned test targets compiled with internal access, including the helpers that call withValue.

adjudications.name: decrement(by:)
adjudications.note: QueueIsolated's decrement helper has no call in the pinned targets. The only other declaration with that spelling is a method on ActorIsolated in App, a different type.

adjudications.name: id1
adjudications.note: The ignore belongs to the entire UUID extension at line 18. Dropping it produces unused findings on id8, id9, mockId(at:) and mockAll. The fact that id1 is used does not make that shared suppression superfluous.

adjudications.name: MockClient
adjudications.note: MockClient only appears at its declaration in Util.swift. No test fixture constructs, subclasses or registers it as a Vapor client. Its protocol conformance supplies no entry point by itself.
